title: El Agente Quntur: Agentic Active-Space Selection for CASSCF
summary: This approach replaces manual, expert-driven active space selection in CASSCF quantum chemistry calculations with a multi-agent LLM harness that plans, executes, and refines computational workflows. It requires access to LLM APIs and incurs variable, potentially unpredictable computational costs and latency due to dynamic inter-agent communication and decision-making. Adoption carries risks of inconsistent active space selection across runs, uncontrolled cost escalation, and failure to converge on correct state assignments without robust stopping criteria.
rationale: This technique is specific to quantum chemistry and requires domain expertise to validate, making it unsuitable for immediate production adoption by a general AI/ML team with constrained infrastructure.
technique: Multi-agent LLM harness for scientific workflow automation
